title: [Shopify] Fix incorrect G/L line on credit memo for refund with exchange item
summary: Shopify connector now correctly handles credit memos for refunds involving exchange items by tracking exchange line items separately and emitting offsetting credit memo lines instead of incorrect G/L refund account entries.
key_points: Tracks exchange items from Shopify via new paginated GraphQL queries on both order and refund imports
Marks exchange-item order lines and skips them during sales invoice creation to prevent double-counting
Generates synthetic negative-quantity refund lines during refund import to offset the exchange value in credit memos
Resolves location from the fulfillment data when creating the credit memo line for exchange items
Fixes incorrect G/L account posting that previously doubled the customer-balance impact of exchange values
